args:
tmpdir=$(mktemp -d)
mkdir -p "$tmpdir/home"
cat > "$tmpdir/airstack.toml" <<'TOML'
[project]
name = "provider-profiles"
deploy_mode = "remote"

[[infra.servers]]
name = "ch-1"
provider = "hetzner"
region = "nbg1"
server_type = "cpx11"
ssh_key = "~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub"

[providers.profiles]
fly = "work"
TOML

AIRSTACK_HOME="$tmpdir/home" cargo run -p airstack-core -- --config "$tmpdir/airstack.toml" provider profile set fly work --env FLY_CONFIG_DIR=$tmpdir/flycfg >/dev/null
AIRSTACK_HOME="$tmpdir/home" cargo run -p airstack-core -- --config "$tmpdir/airstack.toml" provider profile status fly --json >"$tmpdir/status.json"
grep -q '"results"' "$tmpdir/status.json"
grep -q '"scope": "config"' "$tmpdir/status.json"
AIRSTACK_HOME="$tmpdir/home" cargo run -p airstack-core -- --config "$tmpdir/airstack.toml" provider inventory fly --all-profiles --json >"$tmpdir/inventory.json"
grep -q '"scope": "inventory"' "$tmpdir/inventory.json"

steps.msg: provider profile status and inventory are scriptable in json
